inventory_rationale: Closed exact State 6 inventory: all 95 accepted State 5 public operations, six canonical HTTP handlers for the fixed A22 external catalogue, and ten stable internal seams required by accepted State 3 hidden mechanisms. Internal seams cover identity canonicalization/digesting, vocabulary duplicate/issuance mechanics, slot contract normalization/ceiling enforcement, flow graph/effect validation, and owner approval digest/grant coverage; no helper is included only for coverage.
